title: Tongue Twisters
short_description: Hear 100 classic tongue twisters in native voices, then practise them aloud.
full_description:
Red lorry, yellow lorry. She sells seashells. Fischers Fritz fischt frische Fische. कच्चा पापड़, पक्का पापड़.

Tongue Twisters collects 100 traditional tongue twisters in four sections, each recorded by a native voice so you hear exactly how it should sound:

• British English – red lorries, biscuits and seashells
• American English – woodchucks, toy boats, Peter Piper and red leather, yellow leather
• Hindi – in Devanagari, with romanised pronunciation and an English meaning
• German – with an English translation

HOW IT WORKS
Listen to the twister, slow it down if you need to, then say it yourself. Tap "I said it!" each time you get through it and the app keeps count. Ready for more? Try saying it several times in a row without stumbling.

FEATURES
• Native-speaker recordings for every twister
• Three playback speeds: slow, normal and fast
• Practice counter and a "Recommended for you" pick
• Favourites for the ones you want to master
• Pronunciation and meaning hints you can switch on or off
• Light and dark mode
• The app itself is available in 40 languages

Good for language learners, actors, teachers, speech practice or a laugh with friends.

No account and no microphone: the app never records you. It is supported by ads, and you can watch a short video to turn ads off for an hour.

Privacy policy: https://pratiyush.github.io/tongue-twisters/privacy/
